Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ws.Range("A10").Value = 1
        ws.Cells.Font.Name = "Courier New"
        ws.Range(ws.Rows(8), ws.Rows(12)).Clear
        Tried = ws.Range("A1").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("B9").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("XFD12").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("C30").Font.Name & "|" & ws.UsedRange.Address & "|" & ws.Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeLastCell).Address
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\sheet_few.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 1
        ws.Range("A10").Value = 1
        ws.Cells.Font.Name = "Courier New"
        ws.Range(ws.Rows(8), ws.Rows(ws.Rows.Count)).Clear
        Tried = ws.Range("A1").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("B9").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("XFD12").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("C30").Font.Name & "|" & ws.UsedRange.Address & "|" & ws.Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeLastCell).Address
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\sheet_all.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 2
        ws.Range("A10").Value = 1
        ws.Cells.Font.Name = "Courier New"
        ws.Range(ws.Rows(8), ws.Rows(12)).ClearFormats
        Tried = ws.Range("A1").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("B9").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("XFD12").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("C30").Font.Name & "|" & ws.UsedRange.Address & "|" & ws.Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeLastCell).Address
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\sheet_formats.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 3
        ws.Range("A10").Value = 1
        ws.Columns("B:C").Font.Name = "Courier New"
        ws.Range(ws.Rows(8), ws.Rows(12)).Clear
        Tried = ws.Range("A1").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("B9").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("XFD12").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("C30").Font.Name & "|" & ws.UsedRange.Address & "|" & ws.Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeLastCell).Address
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\columns_few.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 4
        ws.Range("A10").Value = 1
        ws.Columns("B:C").Font.Name = "Courier New"
        ws.Range(ws.Rows(8), ws.Rows(ws.Rows.Count)).Clear
        Tried = ws.Range("A1").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("B9").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("XFD12").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("C30").Font.Name & "|" & ws.UsedRange.Address & "|" & ws.Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeLastCell).Address
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\columns_all.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 5
        ws.Range("A10").Value = 1
        ws.Columns("A:XFC").Font.Name = "Courier New"
        ws.Range(ws.Rows(8), ws.Rows(12)).Clear
        Tried = ws.Range("A1").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("B9").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("XFD12").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("C30").Font.Name & "|" & ws.UsedRange.Address & "|" & ws.Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeLastCell).Address
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\nearly_all.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 6
        ws.Columns("A:A").Font.Name = "Courier New"
        ws.Range(ws.Rows(8), ws.Rows(9)).Clear
        Tried = ws.Range("A1").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("B9").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("XFD12").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("C30").Font.Name & "|" & ws.UsedRange.Address & "|" & ws.Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeLastCell).Address
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\a.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 7
        ws.Columns("A:B").Font.Name = "Courier New"
        ws.Range(ws.Rows(8), ws.Rows(9)).Clear
        Tried = ws.Range("A1").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("B9").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("XFD12").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("C30").Font.Name & "|" & ws.UsedRange.Address & "|" & ws.Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeLastCell).Address
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\ab.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 8
        ws.Columns("B:XFD").Font.Name = "Courier New"
        ws.Range(ws.Rows(8), ws.Rows(9)).Clear
        Tried = ws.Range("A1").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("B9").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("XFD12").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("C30").Font.Name & "|" & ws.UsedRange.Address & "|" & ws.Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeLastCell).Address
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\b_xfd.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 9
        ws.Columns("A:IU").Font.Name = "Courier New"
        ws.Range(ws.Rows(8), ws.Rows(9)).Clear
        Tried = ws.Range("A1").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("B9").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("XFD12").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("C30").Font.Name & "|" & ws.UsedRange.Address & "|" & ws.Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeLastCell).Address
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\a_iu.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook

        ws.Range(ws.Rows(8), ws.Rows(9)).Clear
        Tried = ws.Range("A1").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("B9").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("XFD12").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("C30").Font.Name & "|" & ws.UsedRange.Address & "|" & ws.Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeLastCell).Address
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\a_iv.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 11

        ws.Range(ws.Rows(8), ws.Rows(9)).Clear
        Tried = ws.Range("A1").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("B9").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("XFD12").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("C30").Font.Name & "|" & ws.UsedRange.Address & "|" & ws.Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeLastCell).Address
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\b_iw.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 12
        ws.Columns("C:D").Font.Name = "Courier New"
        ws.Columns("F:G").Font.Name = "Courier New"
        ws.Range(ws.Rows(8), ws.Rows(9)).Clear
        Tried = ws.Range("A1").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("B9").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("XFD12").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("C30").Font.Name & "|" & ws.UsedRange.Address & "|" & ws.Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeLastCell).Address
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\two_blocks.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 13
        ws.Columns("A:Z").Font.Name = "Courier New"
        ws.Range(ws.Rows(8), ws.Rows(9)).Clear
        Tried = ws.Range("A1").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("B9").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("XFD12").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("C30").Font.Name & "|" & ws.UsedRange.Address & "|" & ws.Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeLastCell).Address
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\a_z.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 14
        ws.Columns("B:Z").Font.Name = "Courier New"
        ws.Range(ws.Rows(8), ws.Rows(9)).Clear
        Tried = ws.Range("A1").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("B9").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("XFD12").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("C30").Font.Name & "|" & ws.UsedRange.Address & "|" & ws.Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeLastCell).Address
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\b_z.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 15
        ws.Columns("A:C").Font.Name = "Courier New"
        ws.Range(ws.Rows(8), ws.Rows(9)).Clear
        Tried = ws.Range("A1").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("B9").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("XFD12").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("C30").Font.Name & "|" & ws.UsedRange.Address & "|" & ws.Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeLastCell).Address
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\a_c.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 16
        ws.Columns("B:D").Font.Name = "Courier New"
        ws.Range(ws.Rows(8), ws.Rows(8)).Clear
        Tried = ws.Range("A1").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("B9").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("XFD12").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("C30").Font.Name & "|" & ws.UsedRange.Address & "|" & ws.Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeLastCell).Address
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\b_d_one.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 17
        ws.Columns("B:C").Font.Name = "Courier New"
        ws.Range(ws.Rows(8), ws.Rows(57)).Clear
        Tried = ws.Range("A1").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("B9").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("XFD12").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("C30").Font.Name & "|" & ws.UsedRange.Address & "|" & ws.Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeLastCell).Address
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\b_c_fifty.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 18
        ws.Columns("B").Font.Name = "Courier New"
        ws.Columns("D").Font.Name = "Courier New"
        ws.Columns("F").Font.Name = "Courier New"
        ws.Range(ws.Rows(8), ws.Rows(9)).Clear
        Tried = ws.Range("A1").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("B9").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("XFD12").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("C30").Font.Name & "|" & ws.UsedRange.Address & "|" & ws.Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeLastCell).Address
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\three_apart.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 19
        ws.Columns("B:E").Font.Name = "Courier New"
        ws.Columns("C").Font.Name = "Arial"
        ws.Range(ws.Rows(8), ws.Rows(9)).Clear
        Tried = ws.Range("A1").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("B9").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("XFD12").Font.Name & "|" & ws.Range("C30").Font.Name & "|" & ws.UsedRange.Address & "|" & ws.Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeLastCell).Address
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\two_styles.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    End Select
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = Tried & "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 19
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
